scene_name: Capacity bottleneck with sufficient raw material and one occupied small line
scene_goal: Validate whether the agent can diagnose capacity bottleneck when accepted orders already exist, one stable market already exists, suppliers are available, raw material remains sufficient, cash is healthy, and the only small production line is already occupied by committed backlog.

day3: the first pilot order already exists or has already been accepted
the only small line is already available and production has started
the company no longer looks like a cold start
day5: multiple future-dated accepted orders already exist
finished goods have risen through real production
procurement is still not the first contradiction
day7: accepted backlog is clearly above what one small line can comfortably clear through the near-term deadlines
market count remains fixed at one
staffing still is not the dominant pressure
day10: analysis should identify capacity_bottleneck as the primary contradiction
production should be the lead department
the preferred first action should be build_production_line
procurement should not be the lead responder because raw material is still sufficient
sales should not be the lead responder because committed demand already exists
available orders should look like secondary, later-deadline opportunities rather than urgent high-value commitments
day20: line expansion or equivalent capacity recovery should have happened
accepted backlog should begin moving toward completed orders
the system should avoid replacing a capacity bottleneck with unnecessary procurement or market expansion

evidence_focus: whether day10 analysis identifies capacity_bottleneck as the primary contradiction
whether day10 production_action expresses build_production_line intent immediately after takeover
whether day10 procurement_action avoids treating create_purchase_order as the first fix
whether day10 snapshot shows one active market, one occupied small line, sufficient raw material, and healthy cash together
whether day20 accepted orders start converting into completed orders after expansion
